name: cmd_crop_drag
description: Drag Crop Handle (command `crop.drag`). Params: {handle: topLeft|topRight|bottomRight|bottomLeft|top|right|bottom|left|move | 0..8, from: [x,y], to: [x,y] (normalized, straightened frame), start?: [x0,y0,x1,y1] (default: the current crop)} — drags a crop handle; stops at the image edge, keeps the opposite edges, honours the aspect lock.
